generator: Exact local copy of original signal generator with explicit new seed ranges; imports original stock/flow/group/replay primitives unchanged. Source copy is pinned and tests check byte parity after import rewriting.
additionalSignalFeature: Existing strictly validated binary released aggregate announced-workload-pressure flag only; late or absent uses identical lag-only model predictions.
fitTarget: Per-group, per-target residual from unchanged recent-three baseline; all model predictions clamped nonnegative. Direct quarter fit separately from individual monthly fits. Fit informative and no-signal training sets separately, reversal and missing/delayed signals reuse informative fit.
signalCellComparator: Original quarter signal cell means; extend identical fixed residual-mean definition to monthly labels. Require >=10 training cases per cell; absent signal falls back to intercept-only.
controlConstruction: Reporting control masks latest released period fields and exposure using original missing contract. Short support removes released months >=2022-01 (12 dense starting months retained). All methods must block both controls. Scoring actuals withheld whenever base forecast blocked, including all C/D rows.

decisions.scope: Per target, group, arm and tree method. No favorable subgroup promotion after broader failures. Controls must preserve blocking; numeric stress checks cover informative, no-signal, reversed, delayed-signal, missing-signal.

evaluation: MAE, RMSE, prediction-minus-actual bias and paired error deltas on common histories. Independent unit is seed company; groups/scenarios/targets correlated. No uncertainty or p-values.
custody: Commit protocol and implementation before any new generator seed. Generate and commit training input/fit audit before test seeds. Never tune after test generation.
limitations: Entire signal/outcome link imposed by one synthetic generator; changed no-signal/reversal and missing availability are stress checks, not independent real-world validation.
Counts only; no rate target or future headcount forecast. C/D suppressed truth never persisted or scored.
No person-level employment/promotion scoring, production/UI/DB/security/access changes, external data or model input boundary.
Test labels available Oct31 after historical origin; generated outcomes end Sep2026. Oct-Dec forecasts remain unsupported/unscored.
